page.overview:
Who is Crack-Shot Aggy?

Crack-Shot Aggy was a female Human living during the Galactic War. A member of the Dust Vipers gang operating on Tatooine, in 3630 BBY she was guarding the gang's compound near Anchorhead when Eternal Alliance ambushed it, looking to reclaim the stolen security codes of the Alliance base on Odessen. Crack-Shot Aggy fought the intruders, but was overwhelmed and killed.

Crack-Shot Aggy appears in Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne as a boss during the "Done and Dusted" Uprising.
